analysis.project_title: DirectoryHub - Advanced Search & Member Experience Overhaul

metadata.attendees: Alex Rivers (Client, CEO at DirectoryHub), Marcus Bennett (Lead Consultant, AI Tech Consulting), Maya Lin (Senior Solutions Architect)

requirements.description: Distance and radius-based filtering by zip code and user geolocation (5, 10, 25 miles).
requirements.source_passage: We desperately need distance and zip code radius search so visitors can specify 5, 10, or 25 miles.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Visitors can input a zip code or enable location to see members within selected radius.

requirements.description: Interactive Google Maps display on search results page with geocoded member pins.
requirements.source_passage: We also want an interactive map display on the search results page alongside the member cards so users can see pins on the map.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search results render a dynamic map with pins corresponding to matched member listings.

requirements.description: Enhanced member search cards with photos, verified badges, star ratings, and category labels.
requirements.source_passage: On the search cards, we need member profile photos, verified badges, star rating reviews, and their primary service categories.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search cards display member headshots, review ratings, categories, and verified badges.

requirements.description: Member phone number privacy protection (hidden from anonymous public visitors).
requirements.source_passage: We want member phone numbers hidden from anonymous visitors. Only logged-in registered members should be able to see their direct phone number.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Anonymous users see 'Login to View Phone'; logged-in users see direct phone number.

requirements.description: Lead capture contact form with automated email alerts and HubSpot CRM webhook export.
requirements.source_passage: When a lead is submitted... automated confirmation email sent to visitor, notification emailed to member... lead data pushed to HubSpot CRM via webhook.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Lead form triggers transactional emails and HTTP POST webhook payload to CRM endpoint.

requirements.description: Mobile web responsive performance optimization and homepage hero banner update.
requirements.source_passage: Over 65% of our traffic is on smartphones... sluggish on mobile... need fast mobile performance and updated homepage banner.
requirements.speaker: Alex Rivers
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Mobile page load under 2.5s; hero banner uploaded in 1920x600 WebP format.

explicit_exclusions: Native iOS and Android mobile app store development (strictly responsive web).

scope_of_work.project_title: DirectoryHub - Advanced Search & Member Experience Overhaul
scope_of_work.project_objective: Deliver a high-performance, conversion-optimized directory portal for Alex Rivers (DirectoryHub).
scope_of_work.current_problem: Current platform lacks distance radius filtering, causing visitor drop-off and irrelevant search results. Mobile user experience requires optimization, and key commercial checkout and lead export workflows require automated integration to prevent manual administrative overhead.

scope_of_work.proposed_solution: Implement a cohesive, hybrid solution leveraging Brilliant Directories native configuration for core settings (Google Maps radius, payment gateways, review moderation) and dedicated custom modules where out-of-the-box settings are insufficient, ensuring optimal budget allocation and fast delivery.
deliverables: REQ-001: Distance and radius-based filtering by zip code and user geolocation (5, 10, 25 miles). [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-002: Interactive Google Maps display on search results page with geocoded member pins. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-003: Enhanced member search cards with photos, verified badges, star ratings, and category labels. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-004: Member phone number privacy protection (hidden from anonymous public visitors). [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-005: Lead capture contact form with automated email alerts and HubSpot CRM webhook export. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-006: Mobile web responsive performance optimization and homepage hero banner update. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
explicit_exclusions: Native iOS and Android mobile app store development (strictly responsive web).
assumptions_and_dependencies: Client will provide valid administrative API credentials (Google Cloud, Stripe, PayPal).
Brilliant Directories hosted platform uptime and core codebase maintained by vendor.
Work will be verified against agreed acceptance criteria in a dedicated staging environment prior to production launch.
acceptance_criteria: REQ-001: Visitors can input a zip code or enable location to see members within selected radius.
REQ-002: Search results render a dynamic map with pins corresponding to matched member listings.
REQ-003: Search cards display member headshots, review ratings, categories, and verified badges.
REQ-004: Anonymous users see 'Login to View Phone'; logged-in users see direct phone number.
REQ-005: Lead form triggers transactional emails and HTTP POST webhook payload to CRM endpoint.
REQ-006: Mobile page load under 2.5s; hero banner uploaded in 1920x600 WebP format.
client_responsibilities: Provide Google Cloud Console billing account and API keys with Geocoding and Maps JavaScript APIs enabled.
Provide production and sandbox API keys for Stripe and PayPal merchant accounts.
Review and approve staging deployment milestones within 3 business days of delivery.
Supply high-resolution brand assets (transparent PNG logo, 1920x600 hero banner).
open_questions_and_risks: Google Maps API usage quotas: High search volume may incur Google Cloud consumption charges.
Browser geolocation permission: Distance search radius requires end-user browser GPS permission consent.
Third-party API rate limits and webhook delivery guarantees.

proposal.project_title: DirectoryHub - Advanced Search & Member Experience Overhaul
proposal.executive_summary: AI Tech Consulting is pleased to present this technical scope and proposal for Alex Rivers (DirectoryHub). This engagement targets delivering an optimized, modern web solution addressing current user friction, integrating verified platform capabilities, and delivering measurable performance improvements within an estimated 7.0-week delivery window.
proposal.scope_summary: Implement a cohesive, hybrid solution leveraging Brilliant Directories native configuration for core settings (Google Maps radius, payment gateways, review moderation) and dedicated custom modules where out-of-the-box settings are insufficient, ensuring optimal budget allocation and fast delivery.

REQ-002: Interactive Google Maps display on search results page with geocoded member pins. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-003: Enhanced member search cards with photos, verified badges, star ratings, and category labels. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-004: Member phone number privacy protection (hidden from anonymous public visitors). [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-005: Lead capture contact form with automated email alerts and HubSpot CRM webhook export. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
REQ-006: Mobile web responsive performance optimization and homepage hero banner update. [EXISTING CONFIGURATION]
